textos.2 doses com intervalo mínimo de 1 mês. G: 2 doses at least 1 month apart. Groups at high risk of invasive meningococcal disease have a different schedule and boosters.

textos.Avaliar policitemia secundária à hipoxem: Assess polycythemia secondary to chronic hypoxemia and rule out anemia that may worsen dyspnea.
textos.Avaliação da função hepática em paciente: Liver function assessment in patients with diabetes. Important before starting statins and to screen for nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD).
textos.Avaliação da função renal Avaliação de f: Kidney function assessment. Interval of 3-6 months when nephrotoxic drugs are used (eGFR below 60 mL/min/1.73 m² or increased risk of kidney disease).
textos.Avaliação de albuminúria para detecção p: Albuminuria assessment for early detection of kidney damage in people with hypertension
textos.Avaliação de dislipidemia. Intervalo de: Dyslipidemia assessment. Interval of 6-12 months if the last result was abnormal. HIV and ART may increase cardiovascular risk.
textos.Avaliação de distúrbios eletrolíticos e: Assessment of electrolyte disturbances and investigation of secondary hypertension
textos.Avaliação de distúrbios eletrolíticos. I: Assessment of electrolyte disturbances. Important in patients with severe COPD or on diuretics.
textos.Avaliação de função hepática. Intervalos: Liver function assessment. More frequent intervals with hepatotoxic drugs, liver disease or HCV/HBV.
textos.Avaliação de hipertrofia ventricular esq: Assessment of left ventricular hypertrophy, diastolic function and target-organ damage in people with hypertension
textos.Avaliação de risco cardiovascular e rena: Cardiovascular and renal risk assessment in patients with hypertension
textos.Avaliação do metabolismo ósseo e risco d: Assessment of bone metabolism and osteoporosis risk in patients with diabetes.
textos.Avaliação do metabolismo ósseo em pacien: Assessment of bone metabolism in patients with diabetes, especially with kidney disease or osteoporosis. Vitamin D deficiency is common in diabetes.
textos.Avaliação do risco cardiovascular em pac: Cardiovascular risk assessment in patients with diabetes. Perform yearly, or more often if on treatment for dyslipidemia.
textos.Avaliação hematológica em pacientes diab: Hematologic assessment in patients with diabetes. Important to detect anemia, infections and other hematologic changes.

textos.BRCA1/2 na família: ressonância magnétic: BRCA1/2 in the family: yearly breast MRI from age 25, alternating with or added to mammography.

textos.CDH1 na família: ressonância magnética d: CDH1 in the family: yearly breast MRI from age 30, alternating with or added to mammography.
textos.CDH1: endoscopia digestiva alta anual co: CDH1: yearly upper GI endoscopy with multiple biopsies (Cambridge protocol) for those who postpone gastrectomy.
textos.Cirrose: rastreamento de carcinoma hepat: Cirrhosis: hepatocellular carcinoma screening with ultrasound every 6 months (with or without alpha-fetoprotein).
textos.Citologia a cada 3 anos dos 21 aos 29 an: Cytology every 3 years from 21 to 29 years (USPSTF). In Brazil, the Ministry of Health recommends HPV DNA testing every 5 years from age 25, where available.
textos.Clamídia: rastreio na primeira consulta: Chlamydia: screening at the first visit for all. Gonorrhea: for those under 25 or with a risk factor. Repeat in the 3rd trimester if under 25 or at risk.

textos.Dose única a cada gestação. SBIm/PNI: a: Single dose in each pregnancy. SBIm/PNI: from 28 weeks (24-27 at the physician's discretion). ACOG/CDC: 32 to 36 weeks, preferably during the season. The only RSV vaccine licensed for pregnant women.
textos.Dose única anual. Com fator de risco e s: Single yearly dose. With a risk factor and depending on the epidemiological situation, consider a 2nd dose 3 months after the yearly dose.
textos.Dose única anual. Para 60+ a SBIm prefer: Single yearly dose. For 60+ SBIm prefers HD3V; if unavailable, use standard 3V or 4V. With a risk factor and depending on the epidemiological situation, consider a 2nd dose 3 months later.
textos.Dose única para 60-69 anos com maior ris: Single dose for ages 60-69 at higher risk: heart disease, lung disease, diabetes, obesity, kidney disease, liver disease, immunosuppression, frailty or institutionalization.
textos.Dose única para adultos com asma moderad: Single dose for adults with moderate or severe asthma.
textos.Dose única para adultos com doença respi: Single dose for adults with clinically relevant chronic respiratory or cardiovascular disease (COPD, moderate/severe asthma, heart failure, coronary disease, moderate/severe immunodeficiency).
textos.Dose única, conforme situação epidemioló: Single dose, according to the epidemiological situation (outbreak, travel to a risk area). Without ACWY, use meningococcal C conjugate.
textos.Dose única, em qualquer época do ano. Ro: Single dose, at any time of year. Routine from age 70, regardless of risk factors. May be given together with the other vaccines for the age.
textos.Dose única. Indicada em qualquer idade c: Single dose. Indicated at any age with a comorbidity that raises the risk of invasive pneumococcal disease.
textos.Dose única. Já recebeu VPP23: aguardar 1: Single dose. Already received PPSV23: wait 1 year. Incomplete series with PCV13/PCV15 (± PPSV23): complete with PCV20 (2 months after PCV13/15 or 1 year after PPSV23). Complete series (PCV13/15 + PPSV23): additional dose at the physician's discretion.
textos.ECG de 12 derivações - Rastreamento card: 12-lead ECG - cardiovascular screening for hypertension, diabetes or age ≥40
textos.Esquema completo: reforço com dTpa a cad: Complete series: Tdap booster every 10 years. Incomplete: 1 dose of Tdap and complete with Td up to 3 doses with a tetanus component. Unvaccinated/unknown: 1 Tdap + 2 Td (0-2-4 to 8 months). Contact of an infant: consider bringing the booster forward to 5 years. Travel to an area with polio: Tdap-IPV.
textos.Exame de imagem para avaliar complicaçõe: Imaging to assess complications (pneumonia, pneumothorax, heart failure) and exclude other differential diagnoses.
textos.Exame essencial para confirmar o diagnós: Essential test to confirm the diagnosis of COPD, grade the severity of airflow obstruction and monitor disease progression. It should be performed after a bronchodilator.
textos.Fator de risco para diabetes: rastrear d: Risk factor for diabetes: screen for undiagnosed diabetes before 15 weeks.
textos.Fratura de quadril em pai ou mãe é fator: A hip fracture in the father or mother is a major risk factor for fracture: screen before age 65 (postmenopausal women) and men aged 50 to 69 with a risk factor.
textos.Gestante Rh negativo: repetir com 28 sem: Rh-negative pregnant woman: repeat at 28 weeks; if negative, anti-D immunoglobulin at 28 weeks and up to 72 h after delivery (if the newborn is Rh positive).
textos.Hepatite viral crônica: vacinar os susce: Chronic viral hepatitis: vaccinate susceptible people against hepatitis A (and against hepatitis B, in hepatitis C).
textos.Hepatopatia crônica: vacinar contra hepa: Chronic liver disease: vaccinate susceptible people against hepatitis A and B, at any age.
textos.Hipercolesterolemia familiar em parente: Familial hypercholesterolemia in a first-degree relative: lipid panel at any age (cascade screening). LDL-C ≥ 190 mg/dL suggests FH.
textos.Hipertireoidismo: TSH (com T4 livre) a c: Hyperthyroidism: TSH (with free T4) every 4-8 weeks until controlled and then every 3-6 months.
textos.Hiponatremia por diurético, sobretudo em: Diuretic-induced hyponatremia, especially in older adults.
textos.Hipotireoidismo em reposição: TSH anual: Hypothyroidism on replacement: yearly TSH on a stable dose (6-8 weeks after an adjustment).
textos.Imunobiológico ou inibidor de JAK: rastr: Biologic or JAK inhibitor: screen for hepatitis B before treatment (risk of reactivation, especially with rituximab).
textos.Inibidor de aromatase: densitometria no: Aromatase inhibitor: densitometry at the start of treatment and every 1-2 years.
textos.Investigação de apneia obstrutiva do son: Investigation of obstructive sleep apnea, a common cause of resistant hypertension. Indicated for patients with snoring, excessive daytime sleepiness or breathing pauses during sleep.
textos.Investigação de estenose de artéria rena: Investigation of renal artery stenosis as a cause of secondary hypertension. Indicated in patients with resistant hypertension, abrupt onset of severe hypertension, or worsening kidney function after an ACE inhibitor/ARB.
textos.Início do pré-natal fora das janelas de: Prenatal care started outside the ultrasound windows: dating, viability and fetal assessment.
textos.Li-Fraumeni (protocolo de Toronto): ress: Li-Fraumeni (Toronto protocol): yearly whole-body and brain MRI, without contrast when possible.
textos.Li-Fraumeni na família: colonoscopia a c: Li-Fraumeni in the family: colonoscopy every 2-5 years, from age 25.
textos.Li-Fraumeni na família: ressonância magn: Li-Fraumeni in the family: yearly breast MRI from age 20, alternating with or added to mammography.
textos.Medição única na vida adulta para refina: Single measurement in adult life to refine cardiovascular risk. Prefer an isoform-independent assay.
textos.Monitoramento de citopenias relacionadas: Monitoring of cytopenias related to HIV or ART. Repeat in 2-8 weeks when starting or switching ART with zidovudine or other myelotoxic drugs.
textos.Monitoramento de eletrólitos em paciente: Electrolyte monitoring in patients with COPD, especially those on diuretics or corticosteroids. Hypokalemia may occur with beta-agonists.
textos.Monitoramento imunológico de pacientes H: Immunologic monitoring of HIV+ patients. Current CD4: 150 cells/mm³. Essential to assess the urgency of starting ART and the need for prophylaxis of opportunistic infections.
Immunologic monitoring of HIV+ patients. Current CD4: 350 cells/mm³. Essential to assess the urgency of starting ART and the need for prophylaxis of opportunistic infections.
Immunologic monitoring of HIV+ patients. Current CD4: 700 cells/mm³. Essential to assess the urgency of starting ART and the need for prophylaxis of opportunistic infections.
Immunologic monitoring of HIV+ patients. Current CD4: not informed. Essential to assess the urgency of starting ART and the need for prophylaxis of opportunistic infections.

Virologic monitoring. Current viral load: not informed. Goal: <50 copies/mL (undetectable). Confirms ART efficacy and adherence to treatment.
textos.Monitorização de toxicidade em uso de ci: Toxicity monitoring on cyclosporine or tacrolimus.
MEN1: yearly calcium, PTH and prolactin.
textos.NEM2 / carcinoma medular de tireoide fam: MEN2 / familial medullary thyroid carcinoma: yearly calcitonin, metanephrines and calcium.
MEN2 / familial medullary thyroid carcinoma: neck ultrasound.
textos.Pai ou irmão com câncer de próstata: ofe: Father or brother with prostate cancer: offer screening from age 45, with shared decision-making.
textos.Painel lipídico completo (não jejum): Co: Complete lipid panel (non-fasting): total cholesterol, HDL-C, triglycerides, calculated LDL-C and non-HDL-C. Screening every 4-6 years. Consider ApoB if triglycerides are high, or with diabetes or obesity.

Complete lipid panel (non-fasting): total cholesterol, HDL-C, triglycerides, calculated LDL-C and non-HDL-C. Screening every 4-6 years. Consider ApoB if triglycerides are high, or with diabetes or obesity. Dyslipidemia assessment. Interval of 6-12 months if the last result was abnormal. HIV and ART may increase cardiovascular risk.
textos.Para não vacinados previamente: 3 doses: For those not previously vaccinated: 3 doses (0-1-6 months). Hepatitis A at 60+ only in special situations (negative serology, exposure, outbreak).
textos.Para não vacinados: combinada A+B em 3 d: For the unvaccinated: combined A+B in 3 doses (0-1-6 months), or separate vaccines — hepatitis A in 2 doses (0-6 months) and hepatitis B in 3 doses (0-1-6 months). Hepatitis B is free in the PNI; hepatitis A and the combined vaccine, only in private clinics. Indicate only the missing component.
textos.Para o cálculo do FIB-4 (idade, AST, ALT: For calculating FIB-4 (age, AST, ALT, platelets): stratifies the risk of advanced fibrosis; FIB-4 ≥ 1.3 calls for elastography.
textos.Para suscetíveis (sem doença ou vacinaçã: For susceptible people (no previous disease or vaccination): 2 doses 1 to 2 months apart. Consider MMRV if MMR is also needed.
textos.Parente de 1º grau com aneurisma de aort: First-degree relative with an abdominal aortic aneurysm: ultrasound once between ages 65 and 75, in men and women.
textos.Parente de 1º grau com aneurisma ou diss: First-degree relative with a thoracic aortic aneurysm or dissection (or Marfan syndrome): imaging of the aortic root and ascending aorta.
textos.Parente de 1º grau com cardiomiopatia di: First-degree relative with familial dilated cardiomyopathy: ECG and echocardiogram every 3-5 years in adults (earlier if symptoms appear).
textos.Parente de 1º grau com cardiomiopatia hi: First-degree relative with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy: ECG and echocardiogram every 3-5 years in adults (earlier if symptoms appear).
textos.Parente de 1º grau com deficiência de al: First-degree relative with alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency: serum level (and genotyping if low).
textos.Parente de 1º grau com doença celíaca: s: First-degree relative with celiac disease: serology (tissue transglutaminase IgA with total IgA), on a gluten-containing diet.
textos.Parente de 1º grau com doença renal poli: First-degree relative with autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease: kidney ultrasound in the at-risk adult, after counseling on the implications of the diagnosis.
textos.Parente de 1º grau com hemocromatose her: First-degree relative with hereditary hemochromatosis: ferritin and transferrin saturation; if abnormal, test for HFE gene mutations.
textos.Pesquisa de anticorpos irregulares na pr: Irregular antibody screen at the first visit, for all pregnant women. If Rh negative, repeat at 28 weeks.
textos.Polipose adenomatosa familiar: colonosco: Familial adenomatous polyposis: yearly colonoscopy, from age 18.
textos.Polipose adenomatosa familiar: endoscopi: Familial adenomatous polyposis: upper GI endoscopy with assessment of the papilla from age 20-25; interval according to the Spigelman stage.
textos.Protocolo Einstein; não é rastreio unive: Einstein protocol; not universal screening in the Ministry of Health or ACOG guidance.
Yearly lung cancer screening. Indicated for adults aged 50-80 with a 20 pack-year smoking history who currently smoke or quit within the past 15 years. Discontinue once the person has not smoked for 15 years or develops a health problem that substantially limits life expectancy.
textos.Rastreamento de HIV conforme PCDT-IST MS: HIV screening according to the Brazilian STI protocol (PCDT-IST MS 2022). Adolescents and young adults should be tested yearly.
textos.Rastreamento de alterações renais. Inter: Screening for kidney changes. Interval of 3-6 months with nephrotoxic drugs, proteinuria or increased risk of kidney disease.
textos.Rastreamento de aneurisma de aorta abdom: Abdominal aortic aneurysm screening. Men aged 65-75 with COPD or a smoking history ≥10 pack-years.
textos.Rastreamento de disfunção tireoidiana em: Screening for thyroid dysfunction in patients with diabetes, especially type 1. Diabetes and thyroid disease often coexist.
textos.Rastreamento de feocromocitoma em pacien: Screening for pheochromocytoma in patients with resistant hypertension, especially with hypertensive crises, headache, palpitations or excessive sweating.
textos.Rastreamento de hepatite B (HBsAg). Vaci: Hepatitis B screening (HBsAg). Vaccinate non-immune people (anti-HBs negative). Immune people do not need further HBV screening.
textos.Rastreamento de hepatite B (anti-HBs). V: Hepatitis B screening (anti-HBs). Vaccinate non-immune people (anti-HBs negative). Immune people do not need further HBV screening.
textos.Rastreamento de hepatite B. Vacinar pess: Hepatitis B screening. Vaccinate non-immune people (anti-HBs negative). Immune people do not need further HBV screening.
textos.Rastreamento de hepatite C. Solicitar ca: Hepatitis C screening. Order HCV viral load if anti-HCV is positive or acute infection is suspected.
textos.Rastreamento de hiperaldosteronismo prim: Screening for primary aldosteronism, an important cause of resistant hypertension. Collect in the morning after 2 hours upright. A ratio >20-30 suggests aldosteronism.
textos.Rastreamento de nefropatia diabética. Va: Screening for diabetic kidney disease. Values ≥30 mg/g indicate albuminuria and increased risk of kidney disease. Perform yearly.
textos.Rastreamento de osteoporose para preveni: Osteoporosis screening to prevent osteoporotic fractures. Women ≥65 years.
textos.Rastreamento de pré-diabetes e diabetes: Screening for prediabetes and type 2 diabetes. Reference values: <100 mg/dL normal, 100-125 mg/dL prediabetes, ≥126 mg/dL diabetes.

Screening for prediabetes and type 2 diabetes. Reference values: <100 mg/dL normal, 100-125 mg/dL prediabetes, ≥126 mg/dL diabetes. Diabetes screening. Some antiretrovirals may increase the risk of hyperglycemia.
Screening for prediabetes and type 2 diabetes. Reference values: <5.7% normal, 5.7-6.4% prediabetes, ≥6.5% diabetes. Reflects glycemic control over the past 2-3 months.
textos.Rastreamento de retinopatia diabética. R: Diabetic retinopathy screening. Perform a complete dilated eye exam yearly. Diabetic retinopathy is the leading cause of blindness in adults.
textos.Rastreamento de sífilis. Considerar maio: Syphilis screening. Consider more frequent screening with risk or exposure. Non-immune people (anti-HBs negative) do not need further HIV screening.
textos.Rastreamento de tuberculose latente em u: Latent tuberculosis screening on a biologic or JAK inhibitor; with a positive result and active disease ruled out, treat.
textos.Rastreio de colo curto (≤ 25 mm). Com pa: Screening for a short cervix (≤ 25 mm). With a previous preterm birth, measure from 16 weeks.
textos.Rastreio de diabetes gestacional para to: Gestational diabetes screening for all women without a previous diagnosis. IADPSG/WHO criteria: fasting ≥ 92, 1 h ≥ 180 or 2 h ≥ 153 mg/dL (one value is enough).

Gestational diabetes screening for all women without a previous diagnosis. IADPSG/WHO criteria: fasting ≥ 92, 1 h ≥ 180 or 2 h ≥ 153 mg/dL (one value is enough). Outside the 24-28 week window: if not yet done, do it right away.
textos.Repetir a cada trimestre enquanto suscet: Repeat every trimester while susceptible (IgG negative).
Repeat in the 3rd trimester (Einstein/Ministry of Health).
textos.Reteste no 3º trimestre para menores de: Retest in the 3rd trimester for those under 25 or with a risk factor.
SBIm: 2 doses 10 years apart. PNI: single dose if the first was given from age 5. For the international certificate (ICVP), give it up to 10 days before travel.
textos.Síndrome de Cowden (PTEN): ultrassonogra: Cowden syndrome (PTEN): kidney ultrasound every 1-2 years from age 40.
textos.Síndrome de Cowden na família: colonosco: Cowden syndrome in the family: colonoscopy every 5 years, from age 35.
textos.Síndrome de Cowden na família: mamografi: Cowden syndrome in the family: yearly mammography from age 30.
textos.Síndrome de Cowden na família: ressonânc: Cowden syndrome in the family: yearly breast MRI from age 30, alternating with or added to mammography.
textos.Síndrome de Lynch na família: colonoscop: Lynch syndrome in the family: colonoscopy every 1-2 years, from age 20.
textos.Síndrome de Lynch: endoscopia digestiva: Lynch syndrome: upper GI endoscopy with biopsies and H. pylori testing every 2-4 years, from age 30-40.
textos.Teste de HPV de alto risco a cada 5 anos: High-risk HPV test every 5 years from 30 to 65 years. Alternatives: cytology alone every 3 years or co-testing every 5 years.
textos.Teste de resistência genotípica (PR/RT +: Genotypic resistance test (PR/RT +/- integrase gene). Indicated before starting ART and in virologic failure. Essential for choosing the appropriate regimen.
textos.Toxicidade tireoidiana e hepática da ami: Thyroid and liver toxicity of amiodarone.
textos.Uso prolongado de metformina associa-se: Long-term metformin use is associated with B12 deficiency; measure periodically, especially with anemia or neuropathy.
textos.Vacina inativada: 2 doses (0-2 meses; 1-: Inactivated vaccine: 2 doses (0-2 months; 1-2 months apart if immunosuppressed). Indicated from age 18 in immunocompromised people.
textos.Vacinados na infância: reforço aos 11 an: Vaccinated in childhood: booster at age 11 or 5 years after the last dose. Unvaccinated from age 16: single dose. Without ACWY, use meningococcal C conjugate.
textos.Varfarina: INR a cada 4 semanas com dose: Warfarin: INR every 4 weeks on a stable dose (up to 12 weeks if the INR is consistently in range).
textos.Aneurisma cerebral em 2 ou mais parentes: Brain aneurysm in 2 or more first-degree relatives

textos.Cardiomiopatia dilatada familiar na famí: Familial dilated cardiomyopathy in the family
textos.Deficiência de alfa-1 antitripsina na fa: Alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency in the family

textos.Agravante de risco cardiovascular (já co: Cardiovascular risk enhancer (already considered in the SBC category). At intermediate risk, the coronary calcium score may reclassify.
textos.Aplicar os critérios da Dutch Lipid Clin: Apply the Dutch Lipid Clinic Network criteria; cascade genetic testing when the family variant is known. In confirmed FH, risk is not estimated by a score: treat as high risk.
textos.Avaliação oftalmológica com tonometria e: Eye exam with tonometry and fundoscopy every 1-2 years from age 40.
textos.Com câncer colorretal ou de endométrio e: With colorectal or endometrial cancer in first-degree relatives, especially before age 50, consider Lynch syndrome and refer for genetic counseling.
textos.Considerar profilaxia de pneumocistose q: Consider Pneumocystis prophylaxis when there is another immunosuppression factor (another immunosuppressant, hematologic malignancy, vasculitis) and treat or test for strongyloidiasis before maintaining a high dose (endemic area).
textos.Considerar teste genético quando há sínd: Consider genetic testing when there is a known syndrome or variant; if the ascending aorta is not well seen on echocardiography, CT angiography or MR angiography.
textos.Dois ou mais parentes de 1º grau acometi: Two or more affected first-degree relatives, or a known hereditary syndrome, call for assessment at a referral center (MRI or endoscopic ultrasound). A single relative does not indicate screening.
textos.Exame dermatológico de corpo inteiro per: Periodic full-body skin exam and sun-protection counseling.
textos.Exame oftalmológico basal no primeiro an: Baseline eye exam in the first year and yearly retinopathy screening after 5 years of use (earlier if the dose is > 5 mg/kg/day, with kidney disease or with tamoxifen use).
textos.Item marcado implica imunossupressão: a: A selected item implies immunosuppression: the vaccine screening was treated as "Yes" and live attenuated vaccines are not included.
textos.Oferecer aconselhamento e teste genético: Offer counseling and cascade genetic testing when the family variant is known; a negative test for the variant ends the follow-up.

Offer counseling and cascade genetic testing; the tests listed apply to the confirmed carrier and to the untested first-degree relative. Complete physical and neurologic exam every 6-12 months, yearly skin exam and upper GI endoscopy together with colonoscopy. Avoid ionizing radiation whenever there is an alternative.

Offer counseling and cascade genetic testing; the tests listed apply to the confirmed carrier and to the untested first-degree relative. Offer counseling and cascade genetic testing; the tests listed apply to the confirmed carrier and to the untested first-degree relative. Women: counsel about abnormal uterine bleeding and consider endometrial screening from age 35.

Offer counseling and cascade genetic testing; the tests listed apply to the confirmed carrier and to the untested first-degree relative. In carriers of a pathogenic CDH1 variant, discuss prophylactic total gastrectomy between ages 18 and 40.

Offer counseling and cascade genetic testing; the tests listed apply to the confirmed carrier and to the untested first-degree relative. In carriers, colonoscopy starts at 10-15 years; discuss colectomy according to the polyp burden. Consider thyroid ultrasound.

Offer counseling and cascade genetic testing; the tests listed apply to the confirmed carrier and to the untested first-degree relative. In carriers: yearly gastrin and pancreatic imaging; pituitary MRI every 3-5 years.

Offer counseling and cascade genetic testing; the tests listed apply to the confirmed carrier and to the untested first-degree relative. RET gene testing defines management: in carriers, prophylactic thyroidectomy at the age indicated by the risk of the mutation.

Offer counseling and cascade genetic testing; the tests listed apply to the confirmed carrier and to the untested first-degree relative. Female carriers: discuss risk-reducing salpingo-oophorectomy (35-40 years in BRCA1, 40-45 in BRCA2) and risk-reducing mastectomy. Male carriers: clinical breast exam from age 35. Pancreas: screen carriers who also have a family case of pancreatic cancer.
textos.Oferecer teste genético em cascata quand: Offer cascade genetic testing when the family variant is known; depending on the syndrome, exercise test or Holter. Review QT-prolonging drugs.
textos.Pesar o risco antes de prescrever estrog: Weigh the risk before prescribing estrogen (combined contraceptive, hormone therapy). Thrombophilia testing is not routine in asymptomatic people.
textos.Pesquisar e tratar Helicobacter pylori;: Test for and treat Helicobacter pylori; endoscopy according to symptoms and individual risk.
textos.Sem a dose, foi tratado como imunossupre: Without the dose, it was treated as immunosuppressive. Up to 0.4 mg/kg/week (or 20 mg/week, without the weight) counts as low-level immunosuppression.
textos.Sem dose e peso, foi tratada como imunos: Without dose and weight, it was treated as immunosuppressive. Up to 3 mg/kg/day counts as low-level immunosuppression.

textos.Febre amarela: contraindicada na gestaçã: Yellow fever: contraindicated in pregnancy. If it cannot be postponed (outbreak or epidemiological emergency), the health service must weigh risk and benefit.

textos.Vacina de vírus vivo atenuado em pessoa: Live attenuated vaccine in a person living with HIV with CD4+ T cells from 200 cells/mm³: individualized indication, according to the CD4 range and the clinical situation.
Live attenuated vaccine in a person living with HIV: enter the recent CD4+ T-cell count to assess the indication.
textos.Vacina de vírus vivo atenuado: contraind: Live attenuated vaccine: contraindicated in immunosuppression. Exceptions depend on the degree of immunosuppression and must be assessed case by case.

textos.Indicado quando glicemia de jejum ou HbA: Indicated when fasting glucose or HbA1c are in the prediabetes range: it confirms or rules out diabetes (SBD 2024). For routine screening, fasting glucose and HbA1c are enough (ADA 2026). SBD prefers the 1-hour glucose: <155 mg/dL normal, 155-208 prediabetes, ≥209 diabetes; at 2 hours: <140 normal, 140-199 prediabetes, ≥200 diabetes. Not ordered for those who already have diabetes.
